'''2010 Texas Mini Worlds Day 1 Olaf Schroeder DS Bring Him Before Me''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Olaf Schroeder]] at [[2010 Texas Mini Worlds]] (Day 1).

== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Bring Him Before Me / Take Your Father's Place|DS2-D-bringhimbeforeme.gif}}
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Virtual Block 6.2]]
* '''Stage:''' Day 1
